fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. "…Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief." (1 Chronicles 11:6) David had said, "Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander." David put the job on the table, and Joab went up first. Me? I'd have been the one asking who goes second.

Right, baker. "So David took up residence in the fortress; that is why it was called the City of David." (1 Chronicles 11:7) The king moves in and the fortress takes his name. The verse before calls the fortress of Zion the City of David too. My name's carved on my handle, so I know how good it feels to have your name on something.
